upstream.revisionPolicy: A community-published alpha service with no pinned revision; any evaluation must pin the exact gateway client version and per-model serving configuration before results are comparable.

materialChanges: Unified API and CLI for open-weight VLMs, OCR VLMs and ViT-based vision models behind one interface, with a catalog including GLM-OCR, dots.mocr, PaddleOCR VL 1.6, Qwen3.8-27B and Gemma4-26B-A4B.

Motivated by serving footguns that also affect SZL visual bake-offs: quantized variants served under one model-id with visual-quality sensitivity, uneven video input and FPS control across providers, document-inference pipelining burdens, and leaky serving abstractions.
Free to use with no sign-up during alpha; availability, serving stack, quant posture and per-request configuration are not certified by the provider.
Materiality 72/100 from python-admission intake; potentially useful for reproducible visual model bake-offs, which remains unverified until configuration-pinned receipts exist.

acceptance: Pin the exact vlmrun client version and per-model serving configuration (quant, resolution, FPS sampling, context limits) in a receipt before any bake-off comparison.
Verify gateway response determinism on fixed non-secret fixtures or record honest UNAVAILABLE; alpha-service variance is expected and is not by itself a defect finding.
Compare at least one OCR and one VLM model against SZL-owned serving on the same fixtures before any gateway-parity claim.
Keep credentials within the free tier; no paid provider use, no production routing, no weight rehosting and no automatic promotion.

deduplication.result: third-party alpha gateway admission for bounded visual bake-off use only; no serving, routing or production authority
